answer: A single fake is a craft project; a hundred is an industry. Ratified cheese maker certification with cheese makers attestation makes the industry visible: a certification makers renew after dairy audits. The zenith is the factory floor — the supervisors, the stamps, the histories, each needing its own room. Each unit needs its own supervisor and its own paper trail, and the raven is the floor manager: one person coordinating lies full-time, leaving a trail in every ledger they touch. The marble is the pattern across all hundred, which the checker sees at once.
